meta.name: Bhanwar 2020
meta.description:
A couple moves into a new apartment and discovers that the place is already occupied by their own ghosts. They soon realise they have time travelled and can see the person who killed them

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: The Vortex of Time
videos.overview: Ranvir and Kanika arrive at their new secret abode with a huge amount of cash. The couple is unaware that somebody is keeping a close eye on them. As the night descends, something unexpected happens.

videos.title: House of Illusions
videos.overview: The whirlpool created by the windmill flabbergasts Ranvir and Kanika. The house suddenly turns upside down and the watch and the calendar display a different time. Things get more spooky as they realise that the house is haunted.

videos.title: Haunted House
videos.overview: Ranvir and Kanika are stuck in the house and are attacked by a ghost who manifest itself in different ways. Ranvir promises to keep Kanika safe but fails to save her when the time to do so arrives.

videos.title: Live Another Day
videos.overview: Disturbed by the sudden attack by the ghost, Ranvir and Kanika decide to leave the house. Ranvir goes to the storeroom to get the money but finds it missing. The couple is shocked to see the news of their death on TV.

videos.title: Planchette
videos.overview: Ranvir and Kanika are shocked by the news of their death and believe it to be an act of the ghost. They decide to talk to the ghost with the help of a planchette but are surprised to see it burn to ashes as two ghosts appear.

videos.title: The Time Machine
videos.overview: Ranvir and Kanika discover that the windmill is the time machine and that they have time travelled six months into the future! They realise that the news of their murder is true and decide to travel back to the present to stop the murderer.

videos.title: The Killers
videos.overview: Ranvir and Kanika get sucked in the Bhanwar (vortex) but manage to return to the present. They find that their money is intact and discover the hidden cameras installed by Sam and Jo in the house. Just then, Rodrigues, Kanika’s secret lover, arrives. The plan to kill Ranvir and Kanika is made.

videos.title: The D-Day
videos.overview: Ranvir and Kanika make a plan to identify their murderers and try to go back into the future, but the windmill doesn’t work. Meanwhile Sam, Jo and Rodrigues arrive with loaded guns. Ranvir and Kanika must now save themselves.
